sources.name: English Wikipedia
sources.notes: First-class pipeline source via the Wikipedia API. Skip culture, culinary, and toxicity-in-pets sections.

sources.name: World Checklist of Vascular Plants
sources.notes: Local sqlite only. Live POWO is Cloudflare-blocked; do not scrape POWO.

sources.name: Plants For A Future
sources.notes: Reliable habitat line, flowering/seed months, and 'ornamental' / woodland-garden notes. Ignore the related-plants table.

sources.name: Useful Temperate Plants
sources.notes: PFAF sister. Same Ken Fern data; check if PFAF is thin. Do not auto-fetch both.

sources.name: Royal Horticultural Society
sources.notes: Garden measurements (flower length, raceme count, height) and planting types. Search first; plant IDs are not Latin names. Award of Garden Merit supports filterHabitat 2.

sources.name: Lilium Species Foundation
sources.notes: Best wild-habitat and morphology notes for Lilium. Grassland/scrub ecotones, rocky slopes, winter rosette.

sources.name: Go Botany (Native Plant Trust)
sources.notes: New England / northeast North America. Useful when a species is naturalized there. 404 is normal for plants absent from the region.

sources.name: Pacific Bulb Society wiki
sources.notes: Bulb genera. Page titles are irregular (section pages, not always the binomial).

sources.name: Flora of Israel Online
sources.notes: Good for Balkans / Turkey / Levant plants (e.g. Lilium candidum). URLs use a short code, not the Latin name.

sources.name: Minnesota DNR invasive plants
sources.notes: Concrete habitat lists (grassland, prairie, forest edge, yards) for species invasive in the US Midwest. Do not treat noxious-weed status as habitat text.

sources.name: Missouri Plants
sources.notes: Excellent structured English: habit, stems, leaves, inflorescence, flowers, fruits, flowering months, habitat. Missouri / central US flora; 404 is normal for plants not in that flora. Skip lookalikes so another species is not copied.

sources.name: NatureGate / Luontoportti
sources.notes: Reliable morphological English: growing form, height, flower, leaf, fruit, habitat. Nordic/Finnish flora — no page is normal (e.g. Digitalis lanata, Lilium candidum). Search scientific name only; ignore article mentions of other species.

sources.name: EPPO Global Database
sources.notes: Best multilingual common-name table. Search the preferred scientific name, then use https://gd.eppo.int/taxon/{EPPO-code}. Take only names printed for that language. A miss or an empty table is normal. Do not use a hybrid/group hit (e.g. Lilium candidum hybrids).

sources.name: BOTANY.cz
sources.notes: Reliable Central European flora. Czech pages have Popis, Ekologie, Rozšíření, and Czech/Slovak names; some species also have English. Latin slug /cs/{genus-epithet}/; try /en/ first. 404 is normal. Skip related-article and prev/next links so another species is not copied.

sources.name: eFloras (FOC, FNA and others)
sources.notes: Already used in the live catalog. Flora of China and Flora of North America treatments.

sources.name: Ontario Rock Garden & Hardy Plant Society
sources.notes: Occasional habitat one-liners (grassland, woodland edge). Pages can be thin or empty.
